ModMetaData.name: ED x FT Compatibility Patch
ModMetaData.author: kupa_
ModMetaData.description:
A compatibility patch to make Faction Territories and Vassalage work with Economics & Demography.
<size=24>Features</size>
- Faction Territories and Vassalage now accounts for population and wealth from Economics & Demography when deciding if a faction can expand. - When Faction Territories and Vassalage starts building a new settlement, the appropriate amount of wealth is consumed by the faction. - Settlements being built don't count towards goods production. This means that destroying an in-progress settlement can deal a heavy blow to that factions economy as the initial investment will be wasted. - Economics & Demography expansion is forced disabled as it's features and checks are now rolled in to Faction Territories and Vassalage expansion system.
